materials.description: Charred residue left by fire.
materials.name: Soot

materials.description: Choking fumes from burning reagents.
materials.name: Smoke

materials.description: Clear, thin and cheap — the base of most brews. The village well refills it for free.
materials.name: Kelpie Dew

materials.description: Slick and golden; it will not mix with watery liquids and floats on top of them. Burns readily.
materials.name: Mossy Lamp Oil

materials.description: Thick, heavy and sweet. Sinks through watery liquids and flows reluctantly unless warmed.
materials.name: Foxfire Nectar

materials.description: A light, volatile spirit. Blends with water, evaporates well below water’s boiling point and is flammable.
materials.name: Emerald Spirit

materials.description: A vividly coloured essence. Mixes freely with watery liquids and stains the whole brew.
materials.name: Wyrmblood Essence

materials.description: A vividly coloured essence. Mixes freely with watery liquids and stains the whole brew.
materials.name: Verdigris Extract

materials.description: A fine dry meal that piles like sand. Knead it with a watery liquid and it becomes a dough; add more liquid and it thins to a paste.
materials.name: Crag Flour

materials.description: Glittering crystals that dissolve into watery liquids — faster when hot or stirred — making them denser.
materials.name: Mere Crystals

materials.description: A vividly coloured essence. Mixes freely with watery liquids and stains the whole brew.
materials.name: Nightshade Essence

materials.description: Warm, faintly glowing grit. Reacts eagerly and catches fire if overheated in open air.
materials.name: Saffron Cinder Powder

materials.description: Chunks of everlasting rime kept at -30°C. They melt into icy water, chilling the brew — or crush them first.
materials.name: Raven Frost Crystal

materials.description: A heavy, mirror-bright liquid metal. Mixes with nothing and sinks beneath every other liquid.
materials.name: Mercurium

materials.description: Hard luminous shards. Crush them with the pestle; the grains slowly dissolve into spirits.
materials.name: Gloaming Aether Shard

materials.description: Waxy flakes that melt into an oily liquid when warmed and set into a solid cake when cooled.
materials.name: Willow Tallow Chips

materials.description: An effervescent powder. Dissolved together with a certain essence it fizzes, releasing a heavy vapour.
materials.name: Barrow Bubble Salts

materials.description: Softly glowing spores; light enough to float on water until kneaded in.
materials.name: Brinedeep Lantern Moss Spores

materials.description: Blood-red resin lumps. They soften into a very thick, oily liquid only when properly heated.
materials.name: Foxfire Sap of Ages

materials.description: Bottled starlight that glimmers in the dark. Prized by mages.
materials.name: Gloaming Starlight Tincture

materials.description: Dried troll moss. Binds into a tough green paste that toughens the drinker.
materials.name: Thorn Ironwort

materials.description: A heavy marsh gas that pools low. It condenses into a liquid if the brew is chilled near freezing.
materials.name: Emerald Marsh Breath

materials.description: Ash that is still warm a century later. It reacts violently with water.
materials.name: Sunpetal Sunbird Cinders

materials.description: Ink darker than night. It refuses to mix with water or oil and settles in its own layer.
materials.name: Hexberry Shadow Ichor

materials.description: A restorative elixir created by dissolving salt into a vital essence and heating it.
materials.name: Amethyst Restorative

materials.description: A fiery cordial that warms from the inside out.
materials.name: Jadeleaf Warming Brew

materials.description: A glimmering tincture of dissolved moonlight, sought by scholars and wizards.
materials.name: Verdigris Arcane Tincture

materials.description: A dense, protective salve baked from dough and syrup.
materials.name: Bloodroot Fortifying Salve

materials.description: The heavy bubbles released by a fizzing reaction.
materials.name: Fizz Vapour

materials.description: What remains after a fizz.
materials.name: Spent Salts

materials.description: Syrup darkened by fierce heat into a deep, warming caramel.
materials.name: Ember Caramel

materials.description: The legendary cure-all: vitality and arcana in perfect union.
materials.name: Hexberry Panacea

materials.description: Liquid metal infused with crystal — heavy, shining and protective.
materials.name: Starfall Amalgam

materials.description: A blazing brew of rebirth. Dangerous to make, wondrous to drink.
materials.name: Starfall Phoenix Brew

materials.description: A thick protective varnish of melted resin and oil.
materials.name: Flamecap Varnish

materials.description: An icy bloom of crystal patterns suspended in liquid. Only forms in the cold.
materials.name: Skyshard Frostbloom

materials.description: Liquid light. It glows bright enough to read by.
materials.name: Kingfisher Lumen

materials.description: A knotted woodland root that carries strength. Crush or grind it; it gives up far more when steeped in hot water.
materials.name: Dusk Ironroot

materials.description: Soft silvery leaves prized by healers. Grind them into water; gentle warmth draws out their healing.
materials.name: Hollow Silverleaf

materials.description: A poisonous leaf. Its oily extract dissolves in spirits rather than water. Test tiny doses before you trust it.
materials.name: Hollow Nightshade

materials.description: A rare screaming root of transformation. Old grimoires say it wakes fully only in warm spirits.
materials.name: Witch Mandrake

materials.description: Soft meadow petals carrying affection. Delicate: strong heat spoils them.
materials.name: Old Heartpetal

materials.description: A prickly golden flower that warms the blood.
materials.name: Hollow Sunthistle

materials.description: A rare blue clover that brings vivid dreams and clear insight.
materials.name: Witch Dreamclover

materials.description: Soft alkaline chalk from the bank. It neutralises acids. A little water and stirring knead it into a paste.
materials.name: Moss River Chalk

materials.description: A cool mushroom growing beneath the willows. Its essence freezes and subtly changes things.
materials.name: Raven Frostcap

materials.description: A marsh bean: restorative, though a little poisonous unless something cancels its bite.
materials.name: Moon Bogbean

materials.description: A warm flint that releases fire when ground. It barely dissolves unless the water is hot.
materials.name: Raven Ember Flint

materials.description: Naturally loose glittering grains. Knead with a little water for dough; plenty of water makes a shimmering infusion.
materials.name: Star Mica Dust

materials.description: A crumbly yellow crust. Strongly acidic, it etches stone and stings flesh.
materials.name: Thorn Sulphur Crust

materials.description: Glass struck by lightning. It still holds a charge that flows into anything that conducts.
materials.name: Hollow Storm Glass

materials.description: Moss from old barrows, heavy with death magic. Dilute generously and test carefully.
materials.name: Witch Grave Moss

materials.description: A luminous crystal of love and insight. Crush it, then warm it in spirits.
materials.name: Dew Star Quartz

materials.description: A faintly glowing lichen that the wisps feed on.
materials.name: Raven Wisp Lichen

materials.description: A furious red pepper from the crags. Its fire loves oil.
materials.name: Star Dragon Pepper

materials.description: A shed salamander scale, warm to the touch. Only fierce heat dissolves it.
materials.name: Dew Cinder Scale

materials.description: A dark root extract: all of the root’s strength, fully in solution.
materials.name: Steeped Dusk Ironroot

materials.description: A pale, fragrant healing infusion.
materials.name: Hollow Silverleaf Infusion

materials.description: Scorched petals: the love is gone and bitterness remains.
materials.name: Wilted Old Heartpetal

materials.description: The waking root dissolved in warm spirit.
materials.name: Witch Mandrake Tincture

materials.description: Crushed quartz dissolved in warm spirit; it glimmers.
materials.name: Starlit Quartz Tincture

materials.description: Pepper fire carried in oil.
materials.name: Dragonfire Oil

materials.description: The neutral grit left where acid met chalk.
materials.name: Gypsum Grit

reactions.name: Amethyst Restorative
reactions.hint: Dissolve Mere Crystals in Wyrmblood Essence and keep it hot.

reactions.name: Jadeleaf Warming Brew
reactions.hint: Saffron Cinder Powder reacts where it touches warm Verdigris Extract. Stirring spreads the reaction.

reactions.name: Verdigris Arcane Tincture
reactions.hint: Crush Gloaming Aether Shard and dissolve it in warm Emerald Spirit — but don't boil the spirit away.

reactions.name: Bloodroot Fortifying Salve
reactions.hint: Knead Crag Flour with Foxfire Nectar into a dough, then bake it gently.

reactions.name: Effervescence
reactions.hint: Barrow Bubble Salts fizzes when dissolved into Verdigris Extract. The bubbles make a brew lively and volatile.

reactions.name: Ember Caramel
reactions.hint: Heat Foxfire Nectar far beyond boiling water and it darkens.

reactions.name: Hexberry Panacea
reactions.hint: Blend Amethyst Restorative with Verdigris Arcane Tincture while warm, not hot.

reactions.name: Starfall Amalgam
reactions.hint: Mercurium swallows crushed Gloaming Aether Shard wherever they touch.

reactions.name: Starfall Phoenix Brew
reactions.hint: Sunpetal Sunbird Cinders reacts violently with Kelpie Dew — keep the heat under control.

reactions.name: Flamecap Varnish
reactions.hint: Melt Foxfire Sap of Ages into hot Mossy Lamp Oil.

reactions.name: Skyshard Frostbloom
reactions.hint: Melted Raven Frost Crystal and Nightshade Essence combine only when kept near freezing.

reactions.name: Kingfisher Lumen
reactions.hint: Brinedeep Lantern Moss Spores bloom when kneaded into warm Gloaming Starlight Tincture.

reactions.name: Steeped Dusk Ironroot
reactions.hint: Ground Dusk Ironroot steeps into a liquid extract in hot water.

reactions.name: Hollow Silverleaf Infusion
reactions.hint: Hollow Silverleaf infuses in warm (not boiling) water.

reactions.name: Witch Mandrake Tincture
reactions.hint: Witch Mandrake wakes in warm spirit.

reactions.name: Starlit Quartz Tincture
reactions.hint: Crushed Dew Star Quartz dissolves in warm spirit.

reactions.name: Dragonfire Oil
reactions.hint: Ground Star Dragon Pepper pours its fire into warm oil.

reactions.name: Neutralisation
reactions.hint: Moss River Chalk fizzes where it meets Thorn Sulphur Crust and both turn to neutral grit.

laws.name: Forged Vigour
laws.lore: A touch of fire tempers strength and makes it stronger.

current.dialogue: A sweet, smooth a dusky azure tonic for my throat — tonight I perform for a duke!
